name: Shadow Summoner
body:
Creatures you summon gain the power of darkness.

Prerequisites: Spell Focus (Conjuration)

Benefit: Whenever you summon a creature from the summon monster spell list that indicates it is summoned with either the celestial or the fiendish template based on your alignment, you can summon the creature with the shadow creature template instead.
